title: Weekly AI Worldview | X Square’s ¥100M+ Embodied AI Raise, Kunlun Tech Search, Wang Huiwen Back at Meituan AI
summary: One-week global AI flash: China & overseas funding, product launches, and people moves.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Company / Weekly Digest · November 11, 2024

One-week global AI flash: China & overseas funding, product launches, and people moves.

Funding — China

Shanghai Luobo Intelligent (ex-XPeng Robotics product design lead Sun Zhaozhi): multimillion-RMB angel for AI companion robots aimed at young women (not kids) — multimodal LLM RTC A/V, long-term memory, self-learning; first “AI trendy toy” prototype due next year. Team from ByteDance, Huawei. CN companion market framed as potential ¥100B+ in 3–5 years.

X Square (自变量机器人): Pre-A + Pre-A+ totaling ¥100M+ (Delian, Keystone et al.) for next-gen embodied foundation models and scene landing. Founded Dec 2023; dual Robotics Learning + LLM DNA. Claims world’s largest-parameter embodied general-operation model WALL-A on a “unified embodied foundation model” path (generalization, self-learning).

Hangzhou Xuzhishi: multimillion-RMB Series A — AI medicine / brain science; first CN VR therapy suite for cognitive impairment with NMPA device registration; AI + VR/MXR digital therapeutics with personalized rehab paths; quantum encryption + blockchain for privacy.

Funding — Overseas

UnifyApps: $20M Series A from ICONIQ Growth. Founder Pavitar Singh (ex-Sprinklr CTO). Connects SaaS apps/data and lets enterprises build AI chatbots over that graph to cut hallucination. 20+ customers incl. a top global bank and a major telco; offices Gurgaon, Dubai, NYC; ~150 staff.

Industry moves

Kunlun Tech ships Skywork AI Advanced Search — multilevel reasoning for finance (policy, filings) and academia (200M+ English papers); 500K+ char document analysis with multimodal output.

Beijing issues first education-sector AI application guide / work plan: pilot scenes citywide by 2025; scaled, systemic, routine use by 2027; student-centered, privacy-first; high-quality datasets + application test beds.

SK Group first AI Summit at COEX with Nvidia, TSMC et al.; SK hynix to supply next-gen HBM4 early for AI memory demand.

Google to open AI center in Saudi Arabia for Arabic models and “Saudi-specific AI apps” with PIF; Aramco cited 15% oilfield output lift via AI — tension with Google’s prior oil/gas algorithm stance and 2030 emissions goals noted.

Coatue raising ~$1B for AI-heavy flagship (~$50B AUM); 2024: 29 startup bets; AI names include Glean, Scale AI, Skild AI; Philippe Laffont bullish on humanoid robots with AI brains.

People

Wang Huiwen (Meituan co-founder, “No. 2”) returns to lead Meituan AI (GN06) after selling Lightyear Beyond to Meituan for health reasons. Meituan AI social products include “wow” and “Miaoshua”; Yicai: global AI app revenue +51% Jan–Aug 2024, full-year ~$3.3B expected — amid Meituan local-business integration and higher priority on tech/international.

Moonshot / Kimi founders Yang Zhilin & Zhang Yutao face HKIAC arbitration from prior Recursive Intelligence investors (GSR, Jingya, Boyu, Huashan, Wanwu) over alleged fundraising/company formation without waiver — Alibaba (~$1B round) watching after prior corp-dev lead exited.

Caitlin Kalinowski (ex-Meta AR glasses / Orion; ex-Apple MacBook hardware) joins OpenAI for robotics & consumer hardware — possible path with Jony Ive / LoveFrom; OpenAI’s first robotics team rebuild since 2018 wind-down.

— END —
